portefeuille.aidePortefeuilles: Alby Hub, Coinos, Primal, Zeus…: in your wallet, create a “Nostr Wallet Connect” connection (with a budget), then paste the link here. SatsPoint never sees your keys.
portefeuille.revoquerTexte: SatsPoint deletes the connection secret. Also remove the connection in your wallet. Bitcoin payments will be blocked until a new connection is made.
portefeuille.destinationAide: Paste an invoice (lnbc…), an address (name@domain) or an LNURL.
portefeuille.soldeInsuffisant: You are {{sats}} short for this transfer.
portefeuille.budgetTexte: The send budget is set in your wallet when connecting.
portefeuille.destinationInvalide: This destination is not recognised. Check the invoice or the address.
portefeuille.paiementIncertain: The transfer is uncertain. Check your wallet before trying again.
portefeuille.cameraIndisponible: The camera is not available on this device: paste the code.
portefeuille.proprietaireSeulement: Only the owner can send sats.

vide.texte: Connect your Lightning wallet to receive payments directly, with no middleman.

equipe.inviterTexte: They will receive a link valid for 72 hours.
equipe.lienTexte: No text message is sent: share this link with the person. It is valid for 72 hours and can be used once.
equipe.desactiverTexte: Their access is cut immediately, on every device.
equipe.dernierProprietaire: The shop must keep at least one owner.
equipe.dejaDansEquipe: This person is already on the team.
equipe.roleGerant: Sales, items, team and settings. Cannot send sats.
equipe.roleCaissier: Charges only. Sees their own sales of the day.

vide.titre: You are on your own for now
vide.texte: Invite a cashier or a manager: they charge for you, with no access to your money.

reglages.messageRecuAide: Shown at the bottom of the customer's receipt.
reglages.waveLienAide: Link of your Wave merchant page (https://pay.wave.com/m/…).
reglages.paytechTexte: Your keys stay encrypted and are never shown again. The money lands in your own PayTech account.
reglages.secretAide: Leave empty to keep the saved value.
reglages.supprimerTexte: Mobile money will be disabled until new keys are entered.
reglages.unMoyenRequis: At least one payment method must stay active.

vide.texte: Name, city, payment request duration, maximum amount and receipt message: everything is set here.

reglages.paysAide: Changing country turns off the payment methods of the previous country.
reglages.paysProprietaire: Only the owner can change the country.

moyensPays.aide: Turn on the ones your customers use, with your merchant number or link. You confirm each payment received yourself.
moyensPays.vide: No payment method is offered for this country yet.
moyensPays.lienAide: https link provided by the operator
moyensPays.valeurRequise: Enter your number or link first.

demarrage.testExplication: Create a 100 FCFA request and pay it yourself: you will see the green screen and know everything works.
demarrage.termineTexte: Everything works. Charge your first sale.
